chunks.title: SUPERVISED_CLASSIFICATION_RESULTS_2026-09-09.md
chunks.content:
## 直接验证与限制

- 另进程回读600个模型，核对2000条神经模型拟合记录；预测重放最大差0.0，各分类指标独立重算一致。
- 250个监督微调最终重拟合中，250个实际更新了编码器。若内部验证选到前5轮，按原规则保留只训练头的结果；不强迫选择更新后的模型。
- 测试被试未进入该折训练或轮数选择；三内折选择轮数后，在外折全部训练被试上重新拟合。五来源原权重及来源标准化器不变，冻结对照的编码器逐权重回读相等。
- 来源与临床身份分别管理；AAL90统一了输入维度，但不同来源的采集/GSR等预处理差异仍在。来源SRPBS只有9人，不能因某个分数较好就称通用基础模型。
- 99/96是既有混合疼痛状态队列；本次不推断单一病种诊断、连续严重度或临床有效性。既往独立外部未确认的结论继续保留。
- 没有按照外折结果选择新的主要模型、延长预算或调阈值；如需进一步优化，应作为后续开发实验另行记录，并在训练/验证部分选择。

方案与参数见同目录README.md。私有模型、拟合身份和逐人预测保留在本地运行目录，不加入公开Git。

chunks.title: TN_SUPERVISED_DEVELOPMENT_2026-09-11.md
chunks.content:
# DS005713 TN监督开发集与流程测试

本报告整理9月11日已有结果，没有重新训练。分类28人（15 TN、13健康对照）；疼痛回归14人。特征为AAL90静态FC、190×90 ROI时序及每人35个动态FC窗口。

| 工作 | 方法与划分 | 已有结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TN/健康分类 | 3折、训练折内标准化、Logistic，无超参数搜索 | AUC 0.343590；平衡准确率 0.315385 |
| TN疼痛回归 | 3折、训练折内标准化、Ridge | MAE 1.728963；训练折中位数常量 MAE 1.714286 |

验证记录中的PASS表示数据/训练流程检查通过，不表示模型性能合格。分类与回归均为smoke；未使用既有预训练编码器，也未作嵌套调参或独立中心验证。

28人中21人的临床记录来自2.0.1历史版本，7人来自2.0.2；历史记录发表前待作者确认。疼痛标签为入院前一周平均疼痛，与拟议“每日最严重NRS七日均值”不同，不能因MAE低于2宣称目标达标。当前回归也未优于训练折中位数常量。

没有新增视觉批准或放宽QC。以前参与DS自监督预训练的被试，在后续DS内部留出评估中仍须从对应预训练部分排除。

原始逐人标签、影像特征及预测继续保存在受控本地数据包；公开的[构建汇总](../reports/training-results-2026-09-12/runs/tn-supervised-smoke-20260911/build_summary.json)和[验证及测试指标](../reports/training-results-2026-09-12/runs/tn-supervised-smoke-20260911/verification_and_smoke.json)不含逐人记录。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_INPUT_AUDIT_2026-09-09.md
chunks.content:
# 预训练与微调数据一致性核对

核对日期：2026-09-09。来源：实际输入NPZ/原始ROI时间序列、远端有效处理目录中的配置MAT和QC、原始临床表及README。只读核对，没有更改标签、人工QC、科学排除或预处理。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_INPUT_AUDIT_2026-09-09.md
chunks.content:
## 主要结论

没有发现脑区序号错排或Pearson/Fisher-z输入计算错误。数据来源的处理策略和样本构成存在差异，不能将AAL90格式一致表述为全部预处理一致。

| 项目 | SRPBS预训练9人／微调99人 | DS005713预训练36扫描 | ABIDE预训练972人 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 脑区顺序 | 原NPZ标签严格1–90，保留原左右 | 36份ROI名称与DPABI前90标签全部匹配 | 前90个DPARSF ROI列；配套DPABI标签1–90 |
| 图谱几何 | 实际AAL90图谱181×217×181 | 提取代码按AAL116数值1–116，取前90 | 配套DPABI图谱61×73×61；SRPBS图谱最近邻重采样至该网格后前90标签逐体素一致 |
| 全局信号回归 | 不使用；108份实际MAT均确认 | 不使用；36份特征清单确认，其中35份原MAT已回读，1份早期导入配置未在导入目录找到 | 使用，实际包为filt_global |
| 头动模型 | Friston-24＋WM/CSF；FD Power>0.5mm，扩展前1后2帧作为spike回归项 | 已读35份配置同左；早期导入1份单列追溯限制 | 官方DPARSF文档为24参数回归；本轮没有逐人原始回归设计，不能认定spike规则同左 |
| 科学纳入 | 平移<3mm、旋转<3°、扩展censor比例≤20%；通过原数值及人工确认 | 按来源自动QC、人工确认及AAL覆盖≥0.92选入 | 官方功能QC及有限、非恒定ROI信号；主972人没有统一mean FD≤0.2限制 |
| 滤波 | 0.01–0.10Hz | 35份配置同左 | 官方DPARSF文档0.01–0.10Hz |
| FC输入 | 滤波、回归后的未平滑BOLD，固定参考脑掩膜内有效体素ROI均值 | 同类未平滑FunImgRCWF输入；配置中6mm平滑用于其他指标，不能据IsSmooth=1称FC输入已平滑 | 已发布ROI时间序列；未逐人回溯到4D BOLD重新提取 |
| 时间点 | 预训练107–284；微调均240，TR=2.5s | 均190点；原200去前10，TR=3s | 77–315点，多站点采集 |
| FC定义 | Pearson→非对角Fisher-z→零对角→上三角4005边 | 同左 | 同左；训练使用完整corr而非稀疏adjacency |

从原始ROI序列独立重算：SRPBS108份最大Fisher-z误差5.97e-8以内；DS00571336份1.15e-7以内；ABIDE972份1.06e-7以内。误差为浮点精度量级。SRPBS、DS代码极端相关值裁剪边界分别1e-6和1e-7，ABIDE拒绝绝对值达到1的相关；不能称边界处理逐字一致，但当前实际输入重算均吻合。

脑区核对边界：确认标签数组、DS逐ROI名称、现存图谱几何和计算链；未从ABIDE全部原始BOLD重新验证每列空间提取，也未重新运行影像配准。两源GSR差异无法从既成FC中简单逆转。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_INPUT_AUDIT_2026-09-09.md
chunks.content:
## 头动与处理差异

ABIDE的971人有平均FD，137人>0.2mm，1人FD缺失；不能将缺失当作低头动。834人低头动候选已有来源记录，本轮继续保留原972人预训练，以便单独比较微调算法。低头动重建预训练应成为单独数据实验。

SRPBS临床Healthy/Pain平均FD中位数分别0.1865/0.1860mm，扩展censor比例中位数2.08%/3.33%；这些描述量不能证明没有残余头动混杂。99人中91人沿既有T1流程、8人采用保留完整T1的修复流程；本轮未因比较成绩调整其纳入。

108份SRPBS处理配置中，GSR、WM/CSF、Friston-24、FD阈值和扩展窗口一致。DS35份配置的对应参数一致；另1份为imported-pilot-v7，已读取导入标记并定位历史stage1/stage2 QC，特征清单注明no-GSR，但本轮未回读其原MAT。这一项保留为追溯限制，不混同为计算失败。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_INPUT_AUDIT_2026-09-09.md
chunks.content:
## 疼痛标签异质性

实际终点仍为诊断代码5（Pain）对0（Healthy），Stroke不纳入。原README没有提供足以逐人判定神经病理性疼痛病因/亚型的标签；不把研究网站项目名称反推为疾病诊断。

- 当前sup7：49人，Healthy20、Pain29。29名Pain的位置为上肢17、下肢10、面部2；左右为左13、右14、双侧2。其VAS范围2–100，SF-MPQ2范围3–204。
- 当前sup8：50人，Healthy33、Pain17。VAS可用15人，范围0–8，缺失2；疼痛持续时间可用12人，1.5–30年，缺失5。缺少sup7式位置和SF-MPQ2字段。
- 两表VAS原README均只称“VAS for pain”，量表端点和评估时窗不明，不能依据取值范围擅自乘10、合并或生成严重度等级。Pain组中VAS为0也不自动改为Healthy。
- 站点构成：CIN Healthy33/Pain17；OSU Healthy19/Pain27；NKN Healthy1/Pain2。Healthy年龄中位44岁，Pain54岁。站点和年龄差异可能影响分类，不能把模型表现全部解释为疼痛生物学。

本次按站点、临床表补充汇总OOF表现，保存group_metrics.json；分组是描述性复核，不据外折结果选择人群、删除难分样本或重新定义标签。96人敏感性仍仅排除人数不足的NKN，不等于消除所有异质性。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_INPUT_AUDIT_2026-09-09.md
chunks.content:
## 后续优先级

1. 保留同处理来源冻结表示＋正则化分类器；最后一层微调作为候选，不预先承诺提升。
2. 单独比较ABIDE低头动来源和可获得的no-GSR来源；变更来源后重新预训练，不能把现有GSR矩阵伪装成no-GSR。
3. 在训练折内处理年龄/站点/头动混杂，并设计跨表或跨站点的迁移检验；当前3人的NKN不用于稳定站点结论。
4. 单病种、量表统一仍依赖真实病因及测量说明，现有二分类继续按宽泛Pain状态报告。

官方ABIDE预处理说明：https://preprocessed-connectomes-project.org/abide/dparsf.html
本地证据：input_audit.json、processing_numeric_audit.json；原始来源追溯、配置、ROI序列仅存本目录private文件/目录，不纳入Git。

核对时点：2026-09-08 20:38，Asia/Shanghai。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_NEXT_STEP_2026-09-08.md
chunks.content:
## 结论：可继续，解释需保留范围

用户提出的“先预训练，再用新数据微调与测试”可以作为后续路线。本次已实现监督微调组件并在既有真实数据上完成运行验证。**尚未提供新数据集，未开展新的外部验证。** 现有99人全部已参与开发性分析，不能重新划分后称作新独立队列。

另一个正在执行的任务为「检查远端处理进展」（任务ID `01a07bba-ccc5-7590-91d2-9f60f5a58ff7`）。其当前工作是校准/混杂复核和完整嵌套标签置换，目标可行，与新队列迁移互补，不能相互替代。本次只读检查该任务及代码，没有向其发送指令、暂停训练或修改它的文件。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_NEXT_STEP_2026-09-08.md
chunks.content:
## 目标与实现比较

| 项目 | 另一个任务及既有实现 | 本次新增 / 后续工作 | 判断 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 来源预训练 | 五条来源的FC自编码器，最小化无标签重构MSE | 复用全部五条检查点，不按已观察AUC挑选来源 | 已落地；重构能力不是疼痛预测或泛化证据 |
| 临床适配 | 原 `_clinical_adapt` 仍用无标签FC重构，再训练Logistic分类器 | 新增BCE监督微调，疼痛标签直接驱动编码器与预测头更新 | 两种学习目标不同，应明确命名、分别评价 |
| 现有结果可靠性 | nuisance、Raw、固定DS005713三组；站点内置换、重建分层内外折，重新拟合特征选择/调参/分类器 | 保留该工作，不在本任务重复执行 | 可行；检验站点内标签可交换零假设，不能解释为模型等效性检验 |
| 多重比较 | 当前置换代码包含两套队列、3分数+2差值共10项的Holm校正 | 如实保留所有方向和阴性结果 | 有助于约束多重比较；不替代外部验证 |
| 泛化与新队列 | 99/96内部嵌套比较，旧N82已用且匿名队列与旧N82重叠不明 | 新队列的身份、QC、输入和标签先核对，再划分微调/验证/测试 | 当前缺新队列，不能宣称已经实现 |
| 严重度任务 | 当前主要是疼痛/健康二分类 | 连续量表与双任务另行准备 | 新组件只实现分类；VAS口径未解决，未自动启动回归 |

截至核对时，另一个任务校准复核已完成、正式1000次置换尚未确认启动。试跑发现固定DS编码器批量编码导致约2.8e-6的预测差异，该任务正在验证按原批次编码的修复。这个暂时的重放问题不意味着研究目标不可行；置换结论须等真实运行完成。当前代码仅缓存固定来源标准化输出，按原训练/测试批次执行编码。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_NEXT_STEP_2026-09-08.md
chunks.content:
## 本次实际执行

- 新组件：`src/oa_rebuild/supervised_transfer.py`。使用BCEWithLogitsLoss、线性分类头；先5轮只训练头，再5轮小学习率监督微调编码器。冻结对照共训练头10轮。按验证集BCE选择轮次；拟合API不接收测试集。固定来源标准化器不重拟合，原模型深拷贝后保持不变。
- 全部五条来源分别运行冻结编码器与监督微调，共10次；另运行既有Raw FC分类实现作为技术对照。冻结表示＋新训练的头属于 **linear probe**，不是整个模型不接触新数据的零样本测试。
- 使用既定99人主分析第1次重复、第1外折及第1内折：训练52人、验证27人、留出20人。总计220个有限预测。
- 五个监督微调模型均实测编码器更新；五个冻结对照编码器均保持不变；11个模型回读的预测最大差均为0。8项测试覆盖标签驱动更新、父模型不变、测试预测不改参数、身份重叠拒绝、无效输入拒绝和回读一致。
- 接入工具 `scripts/inspect_transfer_cohort.py` 在现有数据上实际核对：AAL90/数组/三分划分通过，五检查点来源重叠0，既往临床身份重叠99，正确输出 `DEVELOPMENTAL_DATA_ALREADY_USED`，独立队列验证为false。
- 私有输出：`tmp/supervised-transfer-rehearsal-20260908/`。这是**技术流程验证**，不是完整嵌套正式比较。没有用本次小运行的AUC选来源、调预算或宣传效果。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_NEXT_STEP_2026-09-08.md
chunks.content:
## 收到新数据后的执行顺序

1. 确认数据名称/路径、匿名身份来源与既往使用史、疼痛标签定义、QC证据和预处理策略。AAL90形状相同不代表策略一致；已知ABIDE GSR与DS005713无GSR差异继续记录。不同命名空间的ID字符串不相同，也不能单独证明主体无重叠。
2. 将新队列按被试划分训练/验证/测试。同一人的多次扫描必须同组；特征变换、训练和轮次/参数选择不使用测试部分。若样本不足，先确定合适的嵌套交叉验证方案，不机械切成小测试集。
3. 分别比较：旧队列训练好的完整分类器直接外推；固定预训练编码器只在新训练部分学习预测头；编码器与头在新训练部分监督微调。保留Raw FC对照，三种结果分别命名。
4. 只有模型与所有选择完成后，才使用新留出测试集计算AUC、AP、Brier/校准及不确定性。真正新独立队列和同一队列内的新留出划分分别报告。

目前实际执行已到“工具实现、真实流程验证和并行目标核对”。下一项外部微调依赖新数据集名称或本地路径；未将已有数据伪装为新数据。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_NEXT_STEP_2026-09-08.md
chunks.content:
## 使用方式

新候选队列的只读计算检查（不等于科学QC或独立性确认）：

```powershell
.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/inspect_transfer_cohort.py --cohort <候选FC包.npz> --splits <三分划分.tsv> --pretraining tmp/clinical-source-pretraining-20260908 --prior-cohort <既往临床FC包.npz>
```

FC包包含 `fc_z`（N×90×90）、`atlas_labels`（1至90）、`subject_ids`（N）、`label`（0/1）；这些是程序输入要求，不能代替原始数据与QC证据。划分表两列为 `subject_id` 和 `role`，角色为 `train/validation/test`。监督组件的 `fit_classifier` 只接受训练/验证数组，测试在返回模型后通过 `predict` 单独调用。已有数据的运行验证入口为 `scripts/rehearse_supervised_transfer.py`，不可用其固定99人设置冒称通用外部评估脚本。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_NEXT_STEP_2026-09-08.md
chunks.content:
## 验证依据

- 本地：`TASK_RECORD.md`的20:13完成记录、`src/oa_rebuild/clinical_classification.py`、`src/oa_rebuild/clinical_permutation.py`、五来源预训练检查点与上述运行目录。
- [scikit-learn 数据泄漏说明](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/common_pitfalls.html)：先划分，训练得到的变换再应用到留出集。
- [scikit-learn 分组置换接口](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.model_selection.permutation_test_score.html)：组内置换保留分组约束，需按具体研究设计解释零假设。

评估等级：**Share with caveats**。组件执行与目标差异已经核验；新的队列泛化及另一个任务的正式置换结论尚未完成。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_OPTIMIZATION_RESULTS_2026-09-09.md
chunks.content:
# 微调方法比较与数据一致性核对

现有99/96队列、相同5重复×5外折×3内折。新训练最后一层微调、L2-SP；冻结特征＋Logistic和原整体微调回读复用，不冒充新训练。
最后一层学习率候选1e-5/1e-4；L2-SP为编码器相对预训练权重的平方差之和，系数0.01/0.1。内层加权BCE同时选择候选与1–30轮，外层全训练者重拟合。分类阈值固定0.5。
冻结Logistic沿用原内层C与特征数选择；与神经分类头的优化器、损失及类别权重不同，是方法比较，不能把差异只归因于冻结编码器。
这些外折结果已用于提出下一轮方法，全部属于开发性比较，不是新的独立验证。旧置换p值不适用于新增路线。

## 核对结论

数据核对见同目录INPUT_AUDIT.md。站点/表分组结果见group_metrics.json；NKN只有3人，不单独据其指标作稳定性结论。

chunks.title: TRANSFER_OPTIMIZATION_RESULTS_2026-09-09.md
chunks.content:
## 结果解读

- SRPBS冻结表示＋Logistic（回读既有结果）99/96准确率66.26%/66.25%，AUC0.694/0.685。其相对Raw的AUC差值条件95%区间分别[-0.031,0.145]和[-0.017,0.153]，均含0，不宣布稳定增益。
- SRPBS最后一层微调99/96准确率61.82%/65.21%，AUC0.635/0.652，比原整体微调0.597/0.623改善；99人AUC仍略低于Raw0.639。其他来源的最后一层微调没有普遍改善，DS路线明显下降。
- L2-SP五来源99 AUC0.582–0.595，96 AUC0.590–0.623；与原整体微调基本接近，未发现值得宣称的普遍优势。
- SRPBS冻结Logistic在sup7/sup8内AUC分别0.620/0.664，低于混合队列0.694。该差异提示应关注人群/站点构成，不能直接认定混合AUC全由疼痛特异信号贡献；这也不是正式跨表迁移测试。
- 500个新增外折模型中495个最终选择的模型实际更新了编码器，5个由内层选择在头部热身期结束；未强行延长训练覆盖验证选择。

验证：13项相关测试通过；600个本轮模型/对照回读、3500条独立拟合记录核对通过；另500个原冻结Logistic/整体微调模型回读通过，预测最大误差均为0。合并22个方法，两设计共21450条OOF预测，重复预测不当成新增被试。旧模型/预训练权重/置换结果保留。

chunks.title: BASELINE_REPORT.md
chunks.content: # OA AAL90 leakage-safe nested-CV baseline

chunks.title: BASELINE_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Outcome

- Dataset: 44 subjects (13 controls, 31 patients).
- Outer validation: RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5 folds x 3 repeats).
- Inner selection: StratifiedKFold(3 folds) grid search by ROC AUC.
- All preprocessing and feature selection occur inside training folds.
- Decision threshold is fixed at 0.5; held-out labels are never used to optimize it.

chunks.title: BASELINE_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Primary repeated nested-CV results

Primary values are the mean and sample SD across repeat-level OOF metrics. The final column is a secondary cross-fitted ensemble estimate with a conditional descriptive bootstrap interval.

| Feature set | Features | Repeat OOF ROC AUC | Repeat OOF balanced accuracy | Sensitivity | Specificity | Cross-fit ensemble AUC (conditional 95% interval) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| demographics | 2 | 0.418 +/- 0.058 | 0.486 +/- 0.050 | 0.484 | 0.487 | 0.407 [0.223, 0.618] |
| timepoints (nuisance) | 1 | 0.637 +/- 0.033 | 0.715 +/- 0.000 | 0.968 | 0.462 | 0.573 [0.342, 0.799] |
| fc | 4005 | 0.747 +/- 0.024 | 0.751 +/- 0.024 | 0.656 | 0.846 | 0.757 [0.600, 0.886] |
| nodes | 360 | 0.816 +/- 0.018 | 0.767 +/- 0.034 | 0.688 | 0.846 | 0.861 [0.730, 0.960] |
| combined | 4365 | 0.743 +/- 0.042 | 0.731 +/- 0.034 | 0.667 | 0.795 | 0.752 [0.596, 0.878] |

chunks.title: BASELINE_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Interpretation limits

- This is a classical leakage-safety baseline, not the final GAT/BrainHGT comparison.
- The 44-subject OA cohort is a methods-development sample and not an external neuropathic-pain validation cohort.
- Study, scan length, and QC attrition are entangled; imaging performance may reflect acquisition/cohort effects.
- The primary estimate is the mean and SD of repeat-level OOF metrics; the repeat-averaged cross-fit ensemble is secondary.
- The conditional subject bootstrap does not include split, model-refit, feature-family-selection, or external-cohort uncertainty.
- Feature families are reported in parallel; choosing the best observed family after evaluation would be optimistic.
- Class-balanced logistic probabilities are not calibrated clinical risks; 0.5 is only a fixed benchmark threshold.
- The fixed 0.5 threshold avoids the legacy optimistic threshold selection on held-out labels.
- The timepoints-only row is a nuisance diagnostic, not a candidate diagnostic model.

chunks.title: BASELINE_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Next model gate

Migrate GCN/GAT/BrainHGT only after this leakage-safe baseline and the AAL90 data contract pass independent review. The graph-model comparison must reuse the same subject IDs and outer folds, and any threshold or hyperparameter selection must remain inside training data.

chunks.title: PHASE1_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md
chunks.content:
# Phase 1 independent review

Review date: 2026-07-14

chunks.title: PHASE1_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md
chunks.content:
## Verdict

The AAL90 Phase 1 engineering and methods-development gate is usable. No blocking error was found in the 76-subject QC, 44-subject dataset construction, finite-value contract, adjacency construction, or fold-local preprocessing. Results are exploratory and are not valid as a clinical-diagnostic or disease-specific performance claim.

chunks.title: PHASE1_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md
chunks.content:
## Findings resolved after independent review

1. The primary performance estimate is now the mean and sample SD of complete repeat-level nested-CV OOF metrics. For node features this is ROC AUC `0.816 +/- 0.018`.
2. The repeat-averaged cross-fit ensemble AUC `0.861` is retained only as a secondary exploratory estimate. Its subject bootstrap is explicitly a conditional descriptive interval and does not cover split, refit, feature-family, or external-cohort uncertainty.
3. Feature families are reported in parallel. Selecting the best observed family after evaluation is explicitly disallowed as a confirmatory conclusion.
4. Study-dependent QC attrition is reported: Study1 patients pass at `5/17`, Study2 patients at `26/39`; study is present for patients and absent for controls.
5. Scan length is stored in the dataset and evaluated as a nuisance-only baseline (`0.637 +/- 0.033` ROC AUC), demonstrating non-trivial acquisition/cohort signal.
6. The dataset stores 264 subject-source provenance records: ROI signals, FC, z-fALFF, z-ALFF, z-ReHo, and z-DC for all 44 accepted subjects, with path, size, mtime, and SHA-256. It also stores hashes for the atlas, labels, participants metadata, config, lock file, and generator code.
7. AAL90 Fisher-Z FC is recomputed from ROI signals as part of QC; the current data has zero disagreements.

chunks.title: PHASE1_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md
chunks.content:
## Remaining scientific blockers

- A nuisance baseline can expose but cannot remove study/acquisition confounding. Random subject-level CV cannot establish that imaging performance is OA pathology rather than cohort or batch structure.
- The 32 AAL90 coverage failures need isolated DPABI/SPM visual review and reprocessing; complete-case selection is not missing at random.
- Controls lack usable study mapping, and there is no matched external cohort.
- Available response/VAS/WOMAC fields are treatment-response outcomes, not neuropathic-pain severity labels.
- GCN/GAT/BrainHGT comparison is a later gate and must reuse the saved subject/fold assignments without post-hoc threshold selection.

chunks.title: PHASE1_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md
chunks.content:
## Verification

- Test suite: `19 passed`.
- Manifest: 76 unique subjects; 44 pass and 32 fail.
- Generated AAL90 data: 44 subjects, shape `[44, 90, 4]` for node features and `[44, 90, 90]` for FC/adjacency; all finite.
- Prediction coverage: 660 rows = 44 subjects x 3 repeats x 5 feature sets, with no duplicate or missing subject-repeat-feature key.
- Provenance: 264 rows = 44 subjects x 6 source roles.
- The four legacy-root mtimes remained unchanged before and after the production run.

chunks.title: PHASE1_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md
chunks.content:
## Read-only review incident

During the first independent review, an attempted legacy PyG import generated five transient `.pyc` files under `[本机路径已省略]`. The reviewer removed those exact five files and verified that no file with the review timestamp remains. No legacy data or code file changed, and the four legacy-root mtimes remained unchanged; the nested `__pycache__` directory mtime is now `2026-07-14T09:44:56.1311241Z`. The post-fix review used read-only text inspection only.

chunks.content:
# OA fMRI Phase 1 data-quality report

Generated: 2026-07-14T09:54:25.926934+00:00

chunks.title: QUALITY_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Dataset and intended grain

- Grain: one row per ds000208 participant.
- Participants profiled: 76.
- Intended use: leakage-safe methods-development baseline, not final neuropathic-pain clinical validation.
- AAL90 acceptance is label-independent: non-zero ROI variance, finite off-diagonal FC, complete predefined feature maps, and consistent metadata.

chunks.title: QUALITY_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Checks performed

- Subject-key uniqueness and join coverage across local labels and official participants metadata.
- Label, age, and sex agreement between metadata sources.
- ROI-signal shape and zero-variance ROI count for AAL116 and the predefined AAL90 subset.
- Fisher-Z FC shape and non-finite off-diagonal entries.
- Presence of z-fALFF, z-ALFF, z-ReHo, and z-DC feature maps.
- Agreement between the independent AAL90 QC rule and the legacy 44-subject artifact.

chunks.title: QUALITY_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Findings

| Severity | Finding | Evidence | Downstream risk | Remediation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| High | Severe ROI coverage/preprocessing failure | 32/76 subjects (42.1%) fail AAL90; failed subjects have 32-80 zero-variance AAL116 ROIs | FC becomes non-finite and silent imputation can create artificial graph structure | Inspect normalization, brain coverage, masks, and atlas alignment; re-run only failed subjects in isolated DPABI output |
| High | Legacy AAL116 graph requires undocumented handling | 12 accepted subjects still have cerebellar-only zero-variance ROIs | Replacing their NaN FC with zero changes edges without an explicit scientific rule | Use predefined AAL90 for the primary audit baseline; retain AAL116 only as a documented sensitivity analysis |
| High | Study/acquisition and QC attrition are entangled | Patient pass rates are Study1 5/17 and Study2 26/39; study is present for 56 patients and 0 controls | Imaging models may learn acquisition/cohort structure rather than diagnosis, and complete-case selection is not missing at random | Treat model results as exploratory; recover failed subjects, add nuisance sensitivity checks, and require matched external validation |
| Medium | Small and imbalanced accepted cohort | 13 controls and 31 patients | High variance and optimistic model selection are likely | Use nested subject-level CV, fixed decision threshold, confidence intervals, and no external-performance claim |
| Medium | Treatment-response labels are not pain-severity labels | 31 selected patients have response/VAS/WOMAC improvement fields | A response model cannot be described as neuropathic-pain severity grading | Label any multi-task response experiment as a methods prototype only |

chunks.title: QUALITY_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Integrity results

- Unique IDs: 76/76.
- Metadata disagreements: 0.
- Missing four-map feature sets: 0.
- Stored FC versus FC recomputed from ROI signals disagreements: 0.
- AAL90 QC passed: 44; failed: 32.
- AAL90 pass set exactly matches the legacy 44-subject set: True.
- Zero-variance ROI union among accepted subjects: [93, 94, 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 114, 115, 116] (all outside AAL90).
- Accepted control/patient timepoint distributions: {'control': {'275': 6, '280': 7}, 'patient': {'272': 1, '280': 30}}.

chunks.title: QUALITY_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Automated acceptance rules

1. Exactly one manifest row per subject and no metadata-key loss.
2. AAL90 node features and FC must be finite; no NaN/Inf imputation is permitted.
3. Every accepted subject must have all four predefined feature maps.
4. Subject IDs must be stored in every generated dataset and prediction file.
5. Preprocessing, feature selection, and hyperparameter selection must remain inside training folds.

chunks.title: QUALITY_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Assumptions and open issues

- AAL labels 1-90 are treated as the predefined cerebrum-only audit atlas; this is not a claim that cerebellar pain biology is irrelevant.
- The 32 failures require visual DPABI/SPM registration and coverage review before any salvage decision.
- The public OA dataset is a chronic-pain/placebo-response methods dataset, not the proposal's final neuropathic-pain cohort.

chunks.title: DS005713_OA_EXPLORATORY_PROTOCOL_2026-08-24.md
chunks.content: # DS005713 to OA exploratory FC-transfer protocol (2026-08-24)

chunks.title: DS005713_OA_EXPLORATORY_PROTOCOL_2026-08-24.md
chunks.content:
## Analysis role and question

This is a post-hoc **exploratory** analysis. It asks whether the independently
prepared, label-free OpenNeuro DS005713 AAL90 FC package can participate in the
existing OA representation-transfer runner and whether its fixed representation
is descriptively competitive with existing target-only baselines. It is not a
preregistered or confirmatory analysis and is not an external OA/pain validation.

The earlier one-epoch real-data smoke run is used only as an execution-contract
check. Its performance values are not used to choose this protocol.

chunks.title: DS005713_OA_EXPLORATORY_PROTOCOL_2026-08-24.md
chunks.content:
## Frozen inputs

- External source: OpenNeuro `ds005713` v2.0.2 FC-only package, 36 scans from
  33 people, including 7 follow-up scans. It contains no diagnosis, pain,
  outcome, or other supervised target fields.
- Target: `phase1-n62-primary`, 62 OA study participants.
- Outer evaluation: the existing target subject-level 5-fold x 3-repeat split
  file. No new split is generated.
- Feature family: AAL90 Fisher-Z functional-connectivity upper triangle only.
- Source/target subject namespaces must be disjoint. Every OA adaptation step is
  restricted to the current outer-training fold.

chunks.title: DS005713_OA_EXPLORATORY_PROTOCOL_2026-08-24.md

## Outcomes and interpretation

The primary descriptive comparison is repeat-level out-of-fold ROC AUC for the
fixed DS005713 encoder versus raw FC. Balanced accuracy and Brier score are
supporting metrics. The OA-internal encoder and DS005713-plus-OA-fold-finetuning
routes are secondary context.

Only descriptive repeat summaries and fold-level audit results will be reported.
No confirmatory p-value or formal permutation claim will be attached to this
post-hoc analysis. Subject-level probabilities, raw datasets, and encoder weights
remain local and are excluded from Git; the published report contains aggregate
results and reproducibility metadata only.
